description: This PHP source file defines a custom exception class 'GrantTypeNotAllowedForClient' in the SuiteCRM OAuth2 API module. It extends a base OAuth2 exception and provides constructor and detail message functions for handling specific OAuth2 grant type errors.

classes.name: GrantTypeNotAllowedForClient
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating an OAuth2 grant type is not allowed for a client. It extends the 'OAuth2' base exception class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message, error code, and previous exception object. It prepends a specific error string to the message.

methods.name: getDetail
methods.description: Returns a descriptive string explaining the cause of the exception, specifically indicating that the grant type is not allowed for the client.
